ROLLING MEADOWS, Ill., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. today announced the acquisition of Panora, Iowa-based AgriServ, Inc. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

AgriServ is a specialist crop insurance broker serving farmers and agribusinesses throughout Iowa. Jerod George, Cory Meinecke, Lucas Wendl and the AgriServ team will join Gallagher's US crop and agricultural brokerage operations and report to Bumpy Triche, head of Gallagher's Southeast retail property/casualty brokerage operations.

"AgriServ has a strong reputation in the agricultural niche and will further expand our crop insurance brokerage capabilities," said J. Patrick Gallagher, Jr., Chairman and CEO. "I am very pleased to welcome Jerod, Cory, Lucas and their associates to Gallagher."

Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. (NYSE:AJG), a global insurance brokerage, risk management and consulting services firm, is headquartered in Rolling Meadows, Illinois. To celebrate the launch of its new routes from Fort Lauderdale, JetBlue is offering limited-time one-way fares starting at $99 in Main and $144 in EvenMore®, available exclusively at jetblue.com and on the JetBlue mobile app  

Fort Lauderdale Expansion Highlights:

  • Two New International Routes on Sale Now: Daily nonstop flights to Tegucigalpa, Honduras, and Grand Cayman, with service beginning February 2027.
  • New JetBlue Destination: First-ever JetBlue service to Tegucigalpa, expanding the airline's Latin America and Caribbean network.
  • Limited-Time Trinidad and Tobago Service: Daily nonstop flights between Fort Lauderdale and Port of Spain from January 29 through February 15, 2027.
  • Record Fort Lauderdale Schedule: More than 150 daily departures expected during peak periods this winter, JetBlue's largest schedule ever at FLL.

FORT LAUDERDALE, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) today announced the next phase of its continued expansion at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL), with flights now on sale for two new daily nonstop international routes to Comayagua, Honduras, home to Palmerola International Airport (XPL), which serves the capital city of Tegucigalpa; and George Town, Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands, via Owen Roberts International Airport (GCM).¹

Tegucigalpa will be a brand-new destination for JetBlue and its second in Honduras, further strengthening the airline’s growing network across Latin America and the Caribbean.

Flights to Grand Cayman will begin February 23, 2027, followed by Tegucigalpa on February 25. JetBlue will also offer limited-time daily nonstop service between Fort Lauderdale and Port of Spain from January 29 through February 15, giving customers a convenient option to travel to Trinidad and Tobago for the country's popular Carnival celebrations.¹

“We're grateful for the way customers across South Florida continue to embrace JetBlue, and we're committed to delivering even more of the destinations and travel options they're looking for,” said Daniel Shurz, senior vice president, revenue, network and enterprise planning, JetBlue. “With new international service to Honduras and Grand Cayman, we're strengthening Fort Lauderdale's role as a key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean, making it easier for customers to reconnect with loved ones, explore new places and travel across our growing network.”

Growing JetBlue's International Network from Fort Lauderdale

The new routes build on JetBlue's continued investment in Fort Lauderdale as a key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean, following the recent launch of service to Barranquilla and Cali, Colombia. By the end of February 2027, with the addition of Grand Cayman and Tegucigalpa, JetBlue will offer nonstop service from Fort Lauderdale to 20 international destinations, providing South Florida travelers with more options while strengthening regional connectivity and expanding the airline's international network. The new routes will also provide convenient connections through Fort Lauderdale to additional destinations across JetBlue's network.

New service to Tegucigalpa expands JetBlue's presence in Honduras, complementing existing flights between Fort Lauderdale and San Pedro Sula. Meanwhile, Grand Cayman adds another nonstop option to one of the Caribbean's most popular leisure destinations.

JetBlue expects to operate more than 150 daily departures from Fort Lauderdale during peak periods this winter, its largest schedule ever at FLL. The continued growth supports the airline's JetForward strategy to build a stronger, more connected network while delivering the destinations, products and perks customers value.

The JetBlue Experience

JetBlue plans to operate the new routes with its Airbus A320 and A220 aircraft. Customers can enjoy the airline's signature Main customer experience, including fast, free, unlimited Fly-Fi®, seatback entertainment at every seat, and complimentary snacks and drinks.²

EvenMore customers enjoy added benefits including extra legroom, priority security where available, early boarding, dedicated overhead bin space and additional onboard perks.

To celebrate the launch of its new international service, JetBlue is offering special introductory one-way fares from Fort Lauderdale to Tegucigalpa and Grand Cayman, giving customers even more reasons to explore new destinations, reconnect with family and friends, and experience JetBlue's award-winning service.

Clients can borrow $5,000 to $35,000 and access funds digitally in one business day

PITTSBURGH, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PNC Bank today announced the launch of a new PNC Personal Loan experience, designed to help clients access funds with greater speed and convenience. Whether managing an unexpected expense, consolidating debt, funding a major purchase or pursuing other financial goals, clients can access funding through a straightforward borrowing experience designed to provide greater certainty and flexibility.

PNC checking clients can borrow between $5,000 and $35,000 through a streamlined digital experience with typical access to their funds within minutes of finalizing their loan. Clients can check their rates and available loan offers through a soft credit pull, without negatively impacting their credit score.

"Financial needs don't always come with advance notice, and our clients deserve a lending solution that helps them act quickly and confidently," said Ronnie Allan, head of Consumer Card and Personal Lending at PNC. "With the modernized Personal Loan experience, we're providing convenient access to funds through a simple digital experience enhanced by the guidance and support of a trusted banking relationship. Whether clients are managing an unexpected expense or pursuing an important goal, we're helping them access the funds they need with greater confidence, convenience and control."

The launch of the modernized personal loan experience reflects PNC's continued focus on delivering simple, client-centered banking experiences. With the ability to check rates without impacting their credit score, plus a fixed interest rate and predictable monthly payment, clients know exactly what to expect throughout the life of the loan, making it easier to budget and plan.

The new experience makes PNC Personal Loans available to more PNC checking clients nationwide. It is now offered in 49 states, including Washington, D.C., and is planning the launch in Florida in December.

"At PNC, we recognize every borrowing need is different," Allan said. "That's why we've designed the PNC Personal Loan to be straightforward from application through repayment, with clear terms, predictable payments and the support clients expect from PNC. It's another way we're helping clients make important financial decisions with confidence."

For more information about the PNC Personal Loan and other personal lending options, visit pnc.com or speak with a PNC representative.

BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Skillsoft® (NYSE: SKIL), a leading AI-native Skills Management Platform, today announced it has been named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Employee Experience – Learning Experience Management (LXM) 2026 Vendor Assessment.1

This recognition builds on Skillsoft’s position as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: North America IT Training Services 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment2 and IDC MarketScape: European IT Training Services 2025 Vendor Assessment3. Skillsoft believes these recognitions reflect its strength across learning experience and IT training, two critical components of how organizations build workforce capability.

As AI, technology and business priorities change, so do the capabilities organizations need to execute. Leaders need a clear view of the capabilities they have today and what they will need next. Skills Management expands the role of learning by connecting workforce development more directly to business needs. The Skillsoft Percipio Platform enables organizations to identify critical skills, build and validate those capabilities, and put them to work against business priorities.

“Learning experience management is evolving as organizations zoom in on skills deficits and leverage skills apart from roles to continuously optimize how employees contribute to outcomes,” said Zachary Chertok, Research Director for HCM Applications and Agents at IDC.

What the recognition means for Skills Management

Skillsoft believes this IDC MarketScape assessment reflects the need to build capabilities that hold up, such as:

  • Proficiency, not completions: Skills mapping grounded in AI-powered assessments of what employees can demonstrate, rather than self-reported or completion data.
  • Development that builds on existing skills: Courses organized around employees’ current competencies and required skills, so people skip redundant training.
  • Learning built around real roles: Structured, multimodal journeys that go beyond content playlists to how people develop complex work.
  • Practice for the real thing: CAISY, Skillsoft’s conversational AI simulator, lets learners rehearse difficult conversations in a safe environment.

Together, these strengths show how learning is evolving beyond course completion to measure what employees can actually do.

“Every business priority depends on capability, and too often leaders lack a clear view of whether they have what they need to execute,” said Raianne Reiss, Chief Marketing and Sustainability Officer at Skillsoft. “Learning is foundational to building that capability, and its value grows when organizations can prove the skills that drive impact. We believe this recognition from IDC MarketScape reinforces the strength of the learning experience at the heart of Skillsoft’s broader Skills Management Platform.”

Learn more and access the IDC MarketScape excerpt, here.

About Skillsoft®

Skillsoft (NYSE: SKIL) is a global leader in Skills Management for the human + AI era. The AI-native Skillsoft Platform gives a clear view of workforce capability, closes critical skill gaps and proves the impact of skills on business outcomes. With Skillsoft, organizations can build AI-ready teams, lower the cost and time of workforce development and reduce execution risk as work continues to change. Thousands of organizations worldwide trust Skillsoft to power workforce readiness. Learn more at skillsoft.com.

About IDC MarketScape

The IDC MarketScape vendor assessment model is designed to provide an overview of the competitive fitness of technology and service suppliers in a given market. The research uses a rigorous scoring methodology based on qualitative and quantitative criteria, resulting in a single graphical illustration of each supplier’s position within a given market. IDC MarketScape provides a clear framework in which technology suppliers’ product and service offerings, capabilities and strategies, and current and future market success factors can be meaningfully compared. The framework also provides technology buyers with a 360-degree assessment of the strengths and weaknesses of current and prospective suppliers.

Ten-building industrial park establishes Speed Bay’s presence in the Houston market

HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Speed Bay Group (“Speed Bay”), a vertically integrated real estate investment and operating platform focused exclusively on shallow bay, multi-tenant light industrial real estate, today announced the acquisition of Greens Road Industrial Park, a 10-building, 249,169-square-foot multi-tenant industrial property in North Houston. This transaction marks Speed Bay’s first acquisition in Houston and advances the firm’s strategy of acquiring well-located, functional shallow bay industrial properties in high-growth, supply-constrained markets across the U.S.

“Houston is one of 19 markets nationwide that we have identified as high-growth metro areas that benefit from strong economic fundamentals, population density and healthy demand from a variety of small-to-medium-sized businesses for shallow bay industrial space,” said Michael Massad, Market Officer at Speed Bay. “Greens Road Industrial Park provided an attractive opportunity for Speed Bay to establish its presence in the Houston market at scale. Its proximity to George Bush Intercontinental Airport is particularly valuable for tenants, including operators with U.S. Customs-bonded and TSA-regulated facilities that are difficult to replicate elsewhere. Combined with its flexible suite configurations and strong connectivity to regional infrastructure and major transportation nodes, the property is well-positioned to serve a broad range of tenant needs.”

Greens Road Industrial Park, which will be rebranded as Airway Logistics Park under Speed Bay’s management, is currently 95% leased and offers dock-high and grade-level loading in a predominantly cross-dock configuration. Across 20 suites, the average suite size is approximately 12,500 square feet. The property also includes three fenced and secured outdoor storage yards and 6.9 acres of excess land on the southern edge of the site. The park is located along Greens Road immediately adjacent to George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH), with convenient access to Houston’s major transportation corridors, including Beltway 8, the Hardy Toll Road and Interstate 45. Its strategic location and flexible configurations support a diverse tenant base, including logistics, distribution and service-oriented businesses requiring proximity to the airport and the broader Houston metropolitan area.

Jimmy Mulvihill, Vice Chairman of Speed Bay, added: “Shallow bay industrial is an often-overlooked asset class that serves as the real estate infrastructure of the U.S. middle market, supporting the businesses that drive local economies. Despite its essential role, the sector remains highly fragmented and underserved by institutional capital. We see a significant opportunity to build a scaled, vertically integrated platform that provides businesses with the functional space they need while offering investors differentiated exposure to the long-term growth of America’s entrepreneurial economy.”

Speed Bay Warehouse Solutions, the operating platform of Speed Bay Group, will oversee leasing, property management and tenant services at Airway Logistics Park.

About Speed Bay Group
Speed Bay Group is a Denver-based real estate investment and management firm focused exclusively on shallow bay, multi-tenant light industrial properties. Founded in 2024 by Evan Zucker and Jimmy Mulvihill – the entrepreneurs behind Black Creek Group, a leading real estate investment management firm acquired by Ares Management (NYSE: ARES) in 2021 – Speed Bay’s senior management team brings an average of approximately 30 years of experience executing across all aspects of the industrial sector. Speed Bay is headquartered in Denver with regional offices in Dallas, Atlanta, and the Northeast, and personnel in Philadelphia, Phoenix, and Tampa. For more information, visit www.speedbay.com.

LONGVIEW, Texas, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Friedman Industries, Incorporated ("Friedman") (NASDAQ/GS: FRD) announced today that it has acquired Behrens Holding, Inc. ("Behrens"), a manufacturer of galvanized and coated steel containers and related metal products based in Winona, Minnesota.

DNV assessment highlights Pioneer’s simplified installation process and approximately 81 person-hours per MWdc for measured tracker and module assembly activities

AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FTC Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FTCI), a leading provider of solar tracker systems, software and engineering services, today announced a DNV technical assessment underscoring the highly constructable design of its Pioneer tracker. The review examines how Pioneer’s hardware, assembly sequence, and material management support field installation.

Following its review of leading tracker manufacturers, DNV concluded that Pioneer appears to have the fewest unique bolt sizes and one of the lowest quantities of bolted structural connections in the industry. The assessment highlights how fewer fastener types and simpler connections reduce hardware handling, tool changes, and assembly complexity.

FTC reports approximately 81 person-hours per MWdc for tracker mechanical assembly and module mounting, based on time trials conducted at the FTC training facility. As part of its assessment, DNV visited FTC Solar’s Austin training facility, reviewed installation documentation, videos and time trial data, and considers the time estimates reasonable based on the information reviewed and conditions shown. Results exclude commissioning, QA/QC and rework, daily setup, equipment moves, and effects of crew learning and turnover, weather, and terrain. DNV notes that the trials show promising potential, but field validation at large scale is still needed.

“Constructability is at the core of FTC Solar and how we design our trackers,” said Anthony Carroll, President and Chief Executive Officer of FTC Solar. “DNV’s assessment validates the design choices behind Pioneer: simplified connections, fewer structural bolt sizes, and an installation sequence built around the needs of field crews. For our customers, that means a tracker designed from the outset to be easier to build.”

Key findings

  • Simpler connections and standardized hardware: Pioneer uses three primary structural bolt sizes - M12, M16, and M20 - with one standardized length per size. Open journals and self-aligning torque tube connections simplify positioning, while bolt-free Python Clip rail attachments, Slide-and-Glide module placement, and Cinch Clip fastening streamline rail and module installation.
  • Efficient tracker assembly: The assessment reports approximately 81 person-hours per MWdc for measured tracker and module assembly activities, based on FTC-provided controlled time trials using a row of 90 modules rated at 710 W each.
  • Installation organization built into the system: Color-coded components help crews identify installation locations, array-specific packaging groups materials by their intended destination, and optional preassembly reduces the work required in the field.

Building on these findings, DNV reviewed robotic approaches to module placement and fastening, two of the most labor-intensive components of tracker installation. Libra Robotics uses Pioneer’s Slide-and-Glide process for module placement, while RoboForce demonstrated robotic Cinch Clip insertion as a proof of concept. FTC Solar is collaborating with multiple robotics companies, using these unique elements of the Pioneer 1P tracker to demonstrate compatibility with different robotic platforms.

OTTAVA™ received U.S. FDA Authorization in July for use in ten general surgery procedures within the upper abdomen

NEW BRUNSWICK, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Johnson & Johnson today announced that Memorial Hermann-Texas Medical Center in Houston, Texas will be the first hospital to install the OTTAVA™ Robotic Surgical System, representing a major milestone in the commercial launch of the company's next-generation soft-tissue robotic platform. Memorial Hermann will be the first hospital in the United States to utilize the system as part of Johnson & Johnson's early access commercial program.

The installation follows U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) De Novo authorization of the OTTAVA™ Robotic Surgical System in July 2026. The system became the world's first FDA-authorized table-integrated soft-tissue robotic surgical system and is authorized for use in multiple procedures in general surgery, including Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, gastrectomy, cholecystectomy, splenectomy, gastric sleeve, small bowel resection, appendectomy, lysis of adhesions, fundoplication and hiatal hernia repair.

"Today's milestone is a significant step for Johnson & Johnson as we commercialize OTTAVA and continue building on our ambition to lead in surgical robotics," said Tim Schmid, Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, MedTech, Johnson & Johnson. "As we bring OTTAVA to market, our focus goes beyond introducing a new technology. We will work alongside health systems and surgical teams, bringing the breadth of Johnson & Johnson to support expanding access to robotic surgery, improve workflow and procedural efficiencies, and address the evolving needs of care teams."

OTTAVA was designed to address some of the most persistent challenges facing hospitals and surgical teams, including operating room space constraints, workflow complexity, growing demand for robotic-assisted surgery and increasing pressure on healthcare resources. By integrating four robotic arms into a standard-sized surgical table, OTTAVA is designed to help hospitals expand operating room capacity, streamline workflows and maintain procedural momentum. The system's architecture includes software-controlled automation capabilities, next-generation instrumentation and compatibility with the Polyphonic™ Digital Ecosystem.

"We designed OTTAVA around the real-world challenges facing hospitals, surgeons and care teams, and collaboration has been fundamental to that process. Working with our first commercial customer is an important step toward realizing our vision of delivering a system designed for the surgeons who use it,” said Hani Abouhalka, Company Group Chair, Surgery, MedTech, Johnson & Johnson. “Our longstanding relationship with Memorial Hermann reflects the kind of partnership we believe is essential to advancing innovation: listening closely, learning from one another and working together to turn real-world insights into meaningful innovation. We look forward to supporting their use of OTTAVA and in the generation of clinical data and real-world evidence to further support the advancement of robotic surgery."

Memorial Hermann-Texas Medical Center served as a clinical trial site to evaluate OTTAVA as part of the Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) program that supported regulatory authorization.

"I am passionate about bringing new technologies into surgery. I’ve had the opportunity to see this system evolve from early development through clinical trials and I believe it will make a meaningful difference for both surgeons and patients,” said Erik Wilson, M.D., Chief of minimally invasive and elective general surgery at UTHealth Houston, director of bariatric surgery at Memorial Hermann-Texas Medical Center, and lead investigator for FORTE clinical study. "This kind of collaboration is essential to advancing robotic surgery, and I’m looking forward to bringing this next chapter to Memorial Hermann."

Johnson & Johnson will continue the commercial launch of OTTAVA with select customers in the U.S., focusing on early customer success while working in parallel to evaluate the platform in additional indications.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Ethics approval received for ACCENT-Mini, evaluating daily-dosed narmafotinib with gemcitabine and Abraxane in metastatic pancreatic cancer
  • The trial builds on encouraging ACCENT results, including a 7.8% complete response rate and 11.1 months median overall survival
  • Safety and pharmacokinetic data from the study expected late Q1/early Q2 2027 to support FDA protocol submission for the registrational study
  • ACCENT-mini is an important step in Amplia’s strategy to build the clinical data to position narmafotinib as a key component of combination therapies for difficult-to-treat cancers such as pancreatic cancer

Melbourne, Australia, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Amplia Therapeutics Limited (ASX:ATX; OTCQB:INNMF) (“Amplia” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has received ethics approval for its ACCENT-Mini trial in metastatic pancreatic cancer. Ethics approval is a key milestone in launching a clinical study, allowing patient recruitment to begin as soon as site approvals are finalised.

ACCENT-Mini will evaluate daily dosed narmafotinib in combination with the chemotherapies gemcitabine and Abraxane®. The trial builds on the encouraging results of the ACCENT trial, in which intermittently dosed narmafotinib plus chemotherapy improved outcomes across all measures of activity compared to chemotherapy alone. Notably, ACCENT delivered a complete response rate of 7.8% and a median overall survival of 11.1 months, with no significant changes to the tolerability profile of chemotherapy alone.

Three (3) clinical trial sites in Australia have been selected for ACCENT-Mini, and trial start-up activities at all sites are well advanced.

Safety and pharmacokinetic data from ACCENT-Mini are expected in late Q1/early Q2 2027. These data will form part of Amplia’s protocol submission to the FDA for the registrational study of narmafotinib in pancreatic cancer.

New patent expands Anixa's intellectual property portfolio for its innovative ovarian cancer vaccine, complementing existing U.S. patent protection

SAN JOSE, Calif., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Anixa Biosciences, Inc. ("Anixa" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: ANIX), a biotechnology company focused on the treatment and prevention of cancer, today announced that the Canadian Intellectual Property Office (CIPO) has issued Patent Number 3,005,025 covering key aspects of Anixa's ovarian cancer vaccine technology. The newly issued patent expands Anixa's international intellectual property protection for a vaccine designed to harness the immune system to potentially prevent or treat ovarian cancer.

The issued patent, exclusively licensed from Cleveland Clinic, is titled, "Ovarian Cancer Vaccines," and the co-inventors are Dr. Justin Johnson, the late Dr. Vincent Tuohy, both of Cleveland Clinic, and Dr. Suparna Mazumder, formerly of Cleveland Clinic. The patent covers methods of immunizing against the extracellular domain of anti-Müllerian hormone receptor II (AMHR2-ED), a protein domain expressed in normal ovaries prior to menopause and also aberrantly expressed in certain types of ovarian cancer.

Anixa's ovarian cancer vaccine, being developed in collaboration with Cleveland Clinic, represents a novel approach to preventing and treating ovarian cancer, particularly among high-risk populations such as those carrying BRCA mutations or with a family history of the disease.

This "retired" protein strategy, developed at Cleveland Clinic and licensed exclusively to Anixa, is designed to train the immune system to recognize and target cells associated with ovarian cancer while seeking to avoid harm to normal tissue. The approach seeks to exploit differences in protein expression between normal tissues and cancer cells, potentially providing a new strategy for cancer treatment and prevention.

The ovarian cancer vaccine is part of Anixa's broader cancer vaccine portfolio, which also includes its investigational breast cancer vaccine developed in collaboration with Cleveland Clinic. The breast cancer vaccine recently completed a Phase 1 clinical trial, funded by a grant from the U.S. Department of Defense, in which all primary endpoints were met. Anixa believes that targeting proteins associated with cancer may offer opportunities to develop preventive vaccines for multiple cancer types.

The Canadian patent issuance complements the Company's existing patent protection in the United States. In July 2025, Anixa announced the issuance of U.S. Patent Number 12,357,593 covering key aspects of its ovarian cancer vaccine technology, including broad claims related to methods of eliciting an immune response targeting AMHR2-ED. Together, these patents provide protection in two important markets for Anixa's approach to developing an ovarian cancer vaccine.

"This Canadian patent further strengthens the international patent protection around our ovarian cancer vaccine program and reinforces our intellectual property position in our AMHR2-ED-targeted immunoprevention approach," stated Dr. Amit Kumar, Chairman and CEO of Anixa Biosciences. "We believe vaccines designed to prevent cancer represent an important frontier in oncology. Our ovarian cancer vaccine is based on a differentiated scientific approach that targets a protein associated with ovarian cancer, with the long-term goal of preventing the disease before it develops. Strengthening our patent portfolio is an important part of our strategy to advance this technology and build a broader platform of cancer prevention vaccines."

About Anixa Biosciences, Inc.
Anixa is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on the treatment and prevention of cancer. Anixa's therapeutic portfolio consists of liraltagene autoleucel, or lira-cel, an ovarian cancer immunotherapy being developed in collaboration with Moffitt Cancer Center, which uses a novel type of CAR-T, known as chimeric endocrine receptor-T cell (CER-T) technology. This technology is differentiated from other cell therapies as the natural ligand of the FSHR receptor, FSH, binds to the FSHR receptor on the tumor cell instead of an antibody fragment. Moffitt is a world leader in cancer immunotherapy treatments, pioneering next-generation cell therapies such as CAR-T, and tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) to harness the power of the immune system. The Company's vaccine portfolio includes vaccines being developed in collaboration with Cleveland Clinic to treat and prevent breast cancer and ovarian cancer, as well as additional cancer vaccines to address many intractable cancers, including high incidence malignancies in lung, colon, and prostate. These vaccine technologies focus on immunizing against "retired" proteins that have been found to be expressed in certain forms of cancer. The breast and ovarian cancer vaccines were developed at Cleveland Clinic and exclusively licensed to Anixa. Cleveland Clinic is entitled to royalties and other commercialization revenues from the Company related to these vaccine technologies. Anixa's unique business model of partnering with world-renowned research institutions on all stages of development allows the Company to continually examine emerging technologies in complementary fields for further development and commercialization. Key Value Drivers of the Transaction Include €3.5 Million (C$5.5 Million) in Equity Consideration and 10% Free-Carried Project Interests

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Teako Minerals Corp. (CSE: TMIN) (FSE: O8U) (OTC Pink: TMINF) (the "Company" or "Teako") is pleased to announce that it has entered into a Definitive Agreement (the "Agreement") with a Dusseldorf Stock Exchange listed company to be renamed DS Deutsche Silber AG (and currently registered as The New Meat Company AG)  (DU: 9AUA) (the "Purchaser"), with respect to the contribution of 90% of Teako's interests in a portfolio of eight Norwegian silver and polymetallic exploration projects (the "Projects") to the Purchaser for aggregate consideration of approximately €3,600,000 (C$5,660,000) consisting of cash and shares in the capital of the Purchaser ("Purchaser Shares"). The Projects include the seven projects that were originally outlined in the Letter of Intent ("LOI") as announced by the Company on July 8, 2026, in addition to an eighth project, Stortuva (as further described below).

In connection with the transactions contemplated by the Agreement, the Purchaser is undergoing a comprehensive corporate restructuring and strategic repositioning toward becoming a mineral resources-focused investment and exploration company. As part of this transformation, the Purchaser intends to focus on the acquisition, development, and management of mineral exploration assets, strategic equity investments, mineral royalty and streaming interests, as well as geological data and exploration technologies.

Teako currently anticipates the closing of the transaction, including the transfer of the Projects and issuance of Purchaser Shares ("Closing"), to be completed in the first quarter of 2027. Pursuant to the Agreement, the cash consideration of €100,000 (approximately C$160,000) payable to Teako, and the annual license fees with respect to the Projects payable to the Norwegian Directorate of Mining, will be paid by the Purchaser on or prior to November 27, 2026. Closing is subject to, among other things, the approval of the Purchaser's shareholders of the issuance of the Purchaser Shares, stock exchange and other regulatory approvals.

Sven Gollan, Teako's Chief Executive Officer, commented: "This transaction will allow Teako to both crystallize value, and maintain meaningful exposure to future discoveries on the Projects through the equity position in the Purchaser and the 10% retained beneficial interest. We're excited about the future vision, and the opportunity to work with other stakeholders of the Purchaser toward the development of these Projects and others, as the Purchaser develops its silver exploration portfolio. At the same time Teako can continue to focus and seek further value from its 100%-owned Norwegian base and critical metal portfolio."

Highlights of the Agreement

  • Retained Project Interests: Teako will vend 90% interests in eight (8) Norwegian high-grade silver projects: Kvittinden, Husvika, Sund, Leland, Greipfjellet, Hyllvatnet, Vinterskard and Stortuva (Figure 1) in to a German-listed silver-focused exploration company. Teako will retain a direct 10% free carried interest in each of the Projects until the point of a Final Investment Decision ("FID") being made by the Purchaser.

  • Equity Position: Subject to the conditions contained in the Agreement, upon Closing Teako will be issued 2,592,592 Purchaser Shares at a deemed price of €1.35 per Purchaser Shares (on a post 10:1 consolidation basis) and having a deemed aggregate value of €3,500,000 (approximately C$5,500,000), which is expected to represent approximately 36% of the outstanding Purchaser Shares pro forma the Purchaser reorganization transactions.

  • Cash Payment and License Fees: Teako will also receive a cash payment of €100,000 (approx. C$160,000), and Purchaser will pay the annual license fees for the Projects, in each case payable by November 27, 2026.

  • Work Commitments: The Agreement contemplates that the Purchaser will use its commercially reasonable efforts to conduct minimum aggregate expenditures of €2,250,000 (approximately C$3,540,000) within 3 years of the Closing. These commitments are to be incurred in aggregate across the Projects.

Terms of the Agreement

Prior to Closing, Teako Minerals Norway AS ("Teako Norway"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Teako, will complete a demerger process resulting in Hanse Silber AS ("Hanse Silber") holding the legal interests to, and 90% beneficial interests in, the Projects, together covering approximately 456 km². Pursuant to the Agreement, Teako Norway will contribute all of the issuad and outstanding shares of Hanse Silber (the "Hanse Silber Shares") to the Purchaser at Closing. Teako Norway has already submitted required documents for the demerger and is awaiting formal approval from the Norwegian authorities. The structure of the transaction is expected to result in the transaction being tax exempt in Norway.

Consideration

Subject to Purchaser shareholder and German regulatory approvals, the aggregate purchase price for the Hanse Silber Shares is €3,600,000, payable as follows: (i) €100,000 (approx. C$160,000), payable by November 27, 2026; and (ii) the issuance of €3,500,000 (approximately C$5,500,000) of Purchaser Shares. Additionally, the Purchaser has agreed to pay the annual license renewal fees in respect of the Projects directly to the Norwegian Directorate of Mining by November 27, 2026. Pro forma the expected transformational transactions being contemplated by the Purchaser, it is expected that Teako will hold approximately 36% of the issued and outstanding Purchaser Shares, which are expected to continue to trade on the Dusseldorf Stock Exchange under the symbol (DU: 9AUA).

Retained Interest and Joint Venture

Under the terms of the Agreement, Teako retains a 10% free-carried beneficial interest in each Project, which cannot be diluted before the point of a FID by Purchaser, with contractual protections extending through the commencement of commercial production. In addition, the Resulting Issuer has agreed to use its commercially reasonable efforts to conduct minimum aggregate expenditures of €2,250,000 (approximately C$3,540,000) within 3 years of the Closing. These commitments are to be incurred in aggregate across the Projects. While it is expected that the Purchaser will establish its own dedicated team of personnel, Teako is expected to become the preferred external provider of Norwegian exploration services (on standard commercial terms) to the Purchaser going forward.

Should Purchaser decide to proceed to production on any Project, the parties will form a joint venture on commercially reasonably terms. Upon FID, the Purchaser will be responsible for sourcing funding to bring the Projects or the Project into production, and Teako shall not be responsible for any costs of establishing the JV or financing the Projects until commercial production has commenced.

The Agreement also provides Teako with certain anti-dilution protections so that any financing of the JV will not impact Teako's 10% free carry prior to the point of commercial production. After the commencement of commercial production, all Joint Venture interest holders will participate in the costs and distributions of the Joint Venture pro rata. Dividends or distributions will start to be distributed to the parties after any financing loans made to the JV are paid off from the revenues from the production. Teako shall have no parent obligations for repayment in the event the mine is closed prior to final repayment of any such loan(s).

Conditions and Timing

Under German law, the Purchaser Shares will be issued through a capital increase in exchange for the Hanse Silber shares (a non-cash contribution). Closing remains subject to a number of conditions, including: (i) approval of the capital increase by at least 75% of the votes at a Purchaser shareholder meeting; (ii) an unqualified report from a court-appointed valuation auditor confirming the value of the Hanse Silber Shares; (iii) completion of Teako's internal pre-closing restructuring so that Hanse Silber holds the Projects; and (iv) receipt of normal course German and Norwegian regulatory approvals. Pursuant to the Agreement, the parties are targeting closing on or before March 31, 2027.

About the Projects

The eight Projects (see Figure 1) that will be contributed by Teako under the Agreement are currently 100% owned by Teako and are located within highly prospective belts for the discovery of high-grade polymetallic and silver deposits in Central and Northern Norway. The Projects, apart from the Stortuva project, were described in Company Press Release dated July 8, 2026.



Figure 1: Location of the Projects

To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
https://images.newsfilecorp.com/files/8258/324869_f2894c6e046e98d6_002full.jpg

Stortuva Project

The 100% owned Stortuva Project consists of six contiguous license blocks in the Vefsn Municipality in Nordland, covering approximately 49.7 km2. The project is located immediately southwest of the town of Mosjøen, and benefits from a highly developed and functional infrastructure, including roads, railways, deep-sea ports, hydro and wind power facilities, and nearby airports (see Figure 2).

The Stortuva Project covers part of the Upper Helgeland Nappe Complex, part of the Uppermost Allocthon of the Scandinavian Caledonides. The area is dominated by a package of gneisses, marbles and amphibolites of Cambrian-Ordovician age which were intruded by several phases of S-type granites of the Bindal Batholith from ~465 Ma through to 424 Ma during the Caledonian orogeny (Nordgulen et al., 1993; Barnes et al., 2007). Exploration by BP Norge Minerals focussed on gold mineralization in the early 1980s. A stream sediment sampling dataset has been digitized from this era (BP Norge Minerals, 1983), with data recorded for Cu, Pb, Zn, As and W on topographic maps. Samples from the Øydalen catchment showing Au values of 308 ppb, 549 ppb and 857 ppb Au (BP Norge Minerals, 1982).



Figure 2: Overview geological map of the Stortuva Project

To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
https://images.newsfilecorp.com/files/8258/324869_f2894c6e046e98d6_003full.jpg

Observations of marbles, sulphidic and tourmaline-filled fault zones and skarn development are all indicated in the project area. The recorded skarn development was observed in the Øydalen area which give further indication of polymetallic potential over the project.

The Stortuva Project is considered prospective for skarn-type mineralisation related to the emplacement of Caledonian felsic intrusions into carbonate-bearing metasediments in the Helgeland Nappe Complex. In addition, there are Au-As veins and breccias across several occurrences around the Tosen fjord ~60 km to the south of the Stortuva Project, close to the Målvika W-skarn (Müller and Furuhaug, 2008). Therefore, this project hosts potential for multiple styles of mineralisation making it a compelling target for modern systematic exploration.

Mr. Roth holds a Ph.D. in Economic Geology from the University of Western Australia, is a Fellow of the Australian Institute of Mining and Metallurgy (AusIMM), and is a Fellow of the Society of Economic Geologists. Mr. Roth has over 35 years of experience in international minerals exploration and mining project evaluation.

About Teako Minerals Corp.:

Teako Minerals Corp. is a Vancouver-based mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition, exploration and advancement of mineral projects in Norway, with its principal exploration focus on copper and zinc in massive sulfide systems. The Company's strategy combines advancing its main projects toward discovery with building a growing portfolio of partner-funded projects in which Teako retains upside exposure to potential future exploration success across a range of commodities. Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Dune Oil Corp. (CSE: DUNE) (OTCQB: DUNXF) (FSE: Z621) ("Dune" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that field operations for the two-dimensional (2D) seismic acquisition program (the "Program") on its onshore M47 oil block ("M47") in Şırnak Province, southeastern Türkiye, commenced on November 11, 2026. The Program is designed to better define fault-controlled structural traps across the licence and to identify high-grade drilling locations for the Company's planned 2027 work program.

Program Commencement and Field Progress

The seismic acquisition contract was signed on October 21, 2026 with Ertürk Group, a Türkiye-based seismic and drilling services contractor headquartered in Diyarbakır, following a competitive tender. Field operations began on November 11, 2026 with line surveying on the first of six planned 2D seismic lines, and the Program has since moved into shot-hole drilling.

Shot-hole drilling began on November 13, 2026 using portable drilling units suited to the area's steep terrain, with holes drilled to the planned depth of 9 metres. As of November 15, 2026:

  • survey crews had positioned and staked all 237 shot points on the first two lines (Lines 101 and 103), representing approximately 27% of the 865 shot points in the current field plan, together with the majority of the receiver stations on both lines; and

  • 57 shot holes have been drilled on Line 101, approximately half of that line's 119 planned shot points, with daily drilling rates increasing as additional drilling units are brought into operation.

Surveying and drilling will continue across the remaining lines, to be followed by field source parameter testing and production recording. The field crew currently numbers approximately 50 personnel, and operations are being carried out in coordination with local authorities and in accordance with the Program's health, safety and environmental (HSE) procedures.

Program Design and Objectives

The Program comprises approximately 45 kilometres across six 2D seismic lines over the M47 licence area (C3 and C4 licences, approximately 310 square kilometres), with 865 dynamite shot points in the current field plan. The acquisition design uses a 50-metre shot-point interval, a 25-metre receiver interval and a minimum of 600 live recording channels, with final acquisition parameters to be confirmed following field source tests.

The objectives of the Program are to:

  • improve definition of fault-controlled structural traps and prospective leads across the licence, particularly in the eastern part of the block;

  • fill gaps in existing seismic coverage; and

  • high-grade and generate additional drillable exploration locations in the South Lead area and development locations in the North Lead, in support of the Company's 2027 drilling program.

The new data will complement the Company's planned re-entry of the C-2 and C-1 wells as well as additional future wells.

Timing, and Next Steps

Field acquisition is scheduled for completion by the end of February 2027, subject to weather, terrain, access and security conditions in the work area. The contractor will carry out field quality control and preliminary field processing during acquisition. Final processing and interpretation of the new data are expected to follow, and the Company expects to finalize and announce new drilling locations following interpretation.

Regional Activity

The Program is underway as activity accelerates in the surrounding area. On November 9, 2026, Turkish Petroleum ("TPAO") announced the Gaziler and Çardaklı oil discoveries in the Cudi-Gabar region, with the Gaziler field lying directly north of M47. TPAO is also advancing development drilling at its Mehmet İrfan Güler oil field on the M47-C1/C2 licences, situated 1-2 km north of Dune's M47-C3/C4 licences.

Scott Lower, President and Chief Executive Officer of Dune Oil Corp., commented:

"Mobilizing crews into the field on M47 is an important milestone for Dune, and in the first five days the team has already completed the survey of two lines and started drilling. This is the program that will sharpen our picture of the faulting and traps across the block and allow us to high-grade drilling locations for 2027. With TPAO continuing to announce discoveries and development drilling immediately around our licence, we believe the timing of this survey is well placed, and we look forward to updating shareholders as acquisition progresses."

Sidus extends nearly 15 years of aerospace manufacturing, proven on its own LizzieSat satellites in orbit, to a new international customer.

CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sidus Space, Inc. (NASDAQ: SIDU) ("Sidus" or the "Company"), a vertically integrated space and defense technology systems integrator, today announced it has secured a purchase order from new customer Argotec Group ("Argotec"), an international space company headquartered in Italy, with operations in Germany and the United States, including a technology hub in California and a second production facility in Melbourne, Florida. Under the purchase order, Sidus will manufacture cable assemblies supporting Argotec's HAWK satellite platform, with delivery expected in the first quarter of 2027.

Sidus designs, builds, and operates its own LizzieSat satellites, producing the cable harnesses, structures, and avionics that fly aboard them in its 35,000-square-foot facility in Cape Canaveral, Florida. That work is proven in orbit: LizzieSat-3 is currently hosting HEO USA's non-Earth imaging payload, which is actively capturing imagery. From the same facility, Sidus delivers end to end satellite infrastructure, mission-critical hardware, and technology integration including Fortis VPX – Maxima, an all-domain digital mission computing platform, all designed, built, tested, and operated in-house. Sidus has manufactured aerospace hardware for nearly 15 years and went public as a NASDAQ-listed company in 2021.

"We design and build the cable harnesses that fly on our own spacecraft, and that flight heritage is exactly what we now bring to other satellite manufacturers." said Carol Craig, Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of Sidus Space. "Growing space companies need suppliers who have already solved these problems on their own spacecraft, and Argotec is the latest international company to put our experience to work, with U.S. operations just down the coast from our Cape Canaveral facility."

Argotec opened its first U.S. production facility, a Space Factory in Melbourne, Florida, near Kennedy Space Center, with an investment of more than $25 million, followed by the establishment of a technology hub in California dedicated to the development of telecommunications technologies. Both U.S. teams support government and commercial missions and will contribute to the continued growth of Argotec's presence in the United States. The company expects to triple the size of its U.S. teams over the next two years, expanding its capabilities and strengthening partnerships across the U.S. space ecosystem.

About Sidus Space  

Sidus Space®, Inc.  (NASDAQ: SIDU) is a vertically integrated space and defense technology company delivering satellite manufacturing and technology integration across all orbits, including LEO, GEO and lunar; all domain digital mission computing solutions; mission planning and management operations; AI enabling products and services; and space and defense hardware manufacturing. With its mission of Space Access Reimagined®, Sidus Space is committed to rapid innovation, adaptable solutions, and the optimization of space systems and data collection performance. With demonstrated space heritage, including designing, manufacturing and operating its own satellite and sensor system, LizzieSat®, Sidus Space serves government, defense, intelligence, and commercial customers around the globe. Strategically headquartered on Florida's Space Coast, Sidus Space operates a 35,000-square-foot space manufacturing, assembly, integration, and testing facility with direct access to nearby launch facilities. For more information, visit: sidusspace.com

About Argotec

Argotec is a space company with offices in Turin, Germany, and the United States. It specializes in manufacturing high-reliability small satellites and their subsystems for missions in low, medium, and geostationary Earth orbits, serving institutions, international agencies, government bodies, and civil protection authorities. In 2022, Argotec was the only company in the world to have two microsatellites operating in deep space as part of NASA's DART and Artemis I missions. Its current projects include HEO, the Earth observation constellation developed under Italy's IRIDE program; HENON, a mission to study solar storms and other space weather phenomena that can impact terrestrial and orbital critical infrastructure; and MiniCOR, a NASA program that will observe coronal mass ejections and the solar wind. Argotec also develops advanced dual-use technologies for inter-satellite cooperation, edge computing, and data intelligence, supporting security and monitoring programs across civil and defense applications. In 2024, Argotec inaugurated SpacePark, its highly automated production facility. In 2026, it opened its U.S. facility in Melbourne, Florida, and established a presence in California focused on telecommunications technologies. In October 2026, Argotec completed a €50 million capital increase through NUO Space S.p.A. The company is a leading player in the international New Space Economy and collaborates with partners worldwide.

Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Avalon Advanced Materials Inc. (TSX: AVL) (OTCQB: AVLNF) ("Avalon" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has closed a non-brokered private placement (the "Offering") of 615,400 flow-through common shares of the Company (the "FT Shares") at a price of C$6.50 per FT Share, representing a premium of approximately 24.3% to the Company's closing share price of C$5.23 on the Toronto Stock Exchange on November 17, 2026, for aggregate gross proceeds of C$4,000,100.

The gross proceeds from the Offering will be used to incur eligible Canadian exploration expenses that qualify as "flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures" under the Income Tax Act (Canada), principally in connection with the advancement of Avalon's Nechalacho Rare Earths and Zirconium Project in the Northwest Territories, subject to applicable tax requirements. Planned activities include exploration drilling and related technical work to support ongoing resource evaluation and the next phase of project development.

"This financing provides targeted capital to advance our work at Nechalacho while leveraging the flow-through structure to support critical minerals exploration in Canada," said Scott Monteith, President and Chief Executive Officer of Avalon. "Our ongoing technical program is intended to strengthen the project's underlying data set and support the work required to progress Nechalacho toward its next development milestones."

Offering details

Each FT Share was issued as a "flow-through share" within the meaning of subsection 66(15) of the Income Tax Act (Canada). The FT Shares were issued pursuant to available prospectus exemptions under applicable Canadian securities laws and are subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the closing date of the Offering.

Red Cloud Securities Inc. ("Red Cloud") acted as finder in connection with the Offering. In consideration for its services, Red Cloud is entitled to a cash finder's fee equal to 7.0% of the gross proceeds attributable to subscribers introduced by Red Cloud and finder warrants equal to 7.0% of the number of FT Shares placed with those subscribers. Each finder warrant is exercisable to acquire one common share of Avalon at C$6.50 per share for a period of 24 months following closing of the Offering.

About Avalon Advanced Materials Inc.

Avalon Advanced Materials Inc. is a Canadian critical minerals company focused on advancing lithium and rare earth elements-two of the fastest-growing segments of the global energy transition. Avalon is advancing the Nechalacho Rare Earth Elements and Zirconium Project in the Northwest Territories, which contains all light and heavy rare earth elements, as well as zirconium, tantalum, and niobium-critical minerals used in advanced technologies across the communications, defense, advanced technologies, and energy sectors. The Company is also focused on vertically integrating the Ontario lithium supply chain through the development of Lake Superior Lithium Inc., Ontario's first midstream lithium hydroxide processing facility, located in Thunder Bay. This facility is expected to serve as a cornerstone of North America's integrated battery materials supply chain, transforming northern Ontario lithium into essential inputs for transportation, grid storage, and advanced manufacturing.

New York, New York--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Sparta Commercial Services, Inc. (OTCQB: SRCO) ("Sparta" or the "Company"), a provider of municipal and other financing solutions, today announced the completion of an additional municipal financing transaction with Hyde County, North Carolina through Sparta's Municipal Finance Program.

This marks the third municipal financing transaction Sparta has completed with Hyde County since 2018 and supported the Hyde County Emergency Services Department's acquisition of two new ambulances.

"Over the years, Sparta has proven to be a reliable financing partner for Hyde County," said Joey Williams, Emergency Management Director for Hyde County. "Their team understands the operational and budgetary realities municipalities face, and they consistently provide a financing process that is efficient, flexible, and easy to navigate. These new ambulances are critical to helping us continue delivering emergency services to our community."

Sparta's Municipal Finance Program helps municipalities and public agencies secure the equipment and infrastructure they need through customized financing solutions designed to preserve annual operating budgets and reduce large upfront capital expenditures. The program finances a broad spectrum of essential-use assets, including ambulances, fire and rescue equipment, law enforcement vehicles, public transportation assets, and a variety of other mission-critical municipal equipment.

"We value long-term relationships with municipalities and are proud when clients continue to return to Sparta for additional financing needs," said Anthony Havens, Chief Executive Officer of Sparta Commercial Services. "Repeat business from Hyde County reflects the trust we work hard to build with municipal clients and equipment providers alike. Our goal is to help municipalities access the essential equipment they need today while preserving financial flexibility for the future."
